unit: instrument (an Act, SI, Measure or Order the publisher lists)
method: entry walk of legislation.gov.uk/asc/<year>/data.feed, both id forms recorded
notes: EXACT: the denominator is legislation.gov.uk's own entry walk and the numerator is a lookup of those ids against corpus_sections; the same comparison reports gaps for every other type. matched on either id form (regnal and calendar). hollow = instruments whose every section is a dot leader; a FLOOR, section_repeals does not hold them all (OI-6).
